page_title: WHU 2-1 WOL | West Ham v Wolves 09/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Mario Lemina (Wolves) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+10' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+10' John Brooks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
90+5' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Lukasz Fabianski (West Ham) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
90+4' Lukasz Fabianski (West Ham) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle.

90+3' What an opportunity! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
90+2' John Brooks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Nelson Semedo (Wolves) brought his opponent down.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) coming on for Emerson.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edson Alvarez leaves the pitch and Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) comes on.
87' Julen Lopetegui prepares a substitution. Mohammed Kudus is replaced by Guido Rodriguez (West Ham).
87' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
86' Here's the change. Rayan Ait-Nouri leaves the pitch and Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) comes on as a substitute.
85' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Wolves, play can continue.
85' Play continues despite the shouts by some Wolves players for a penalty. Wait! Referee John Brooks interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
84' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
83' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

81' Mario Lemina (Wolves) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Lukasz Fabianski was alert and the score remained the same.

79' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) with a great individual effort and attempt from long range. The shot went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was prepared and managed to keep the ball out.
78' Gary O'Neil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Doyle (Wolves) replacing Joao Gomes.
76' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
75' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner kick, but Sam Johnstone reads it well and stops the effort.
75' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. West Ham have a corner.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Danny Ings (West Ham) is replacing Crysencio Summerville.
72' 2 - 1 Goal! Mohammed Kudus tees up Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
70' Joao Gomes (Wolves) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' 1 - 1 Matt Doherty (Wolves) gets on the end of a long pass that is slotted through the defence and easily sends the ball into the bottom left corner!
68' John Brooks blows his whistle after Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
65' The linesman raises his flag. Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
64' The game has come to an end for Carlos Soler. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lucas Paqueta (West Ham).
63' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Joao Gomes (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
62' It's time for a substitution. Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) comes on in place of Jorgen Strand Larsen.
62' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) replaces Andre.
62' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The West Ham players look gutted.
61' Wait! Referee John Brooks has indicated he is going to review the West Ham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

60' Goal! Jarrod Bowen displays great vision and sends a pass to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 2:0.
57' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) loses the defending players and unloads a powerful, but inaccurate effort from long distance. The goalkeeper remains completely calm as the ball ends somewhere in row Z.
55' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
54' 1 - 0 The score has changed – 1:0. Jarrod Bowen sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) jumps highest and plants a header into the top right corner.
53' There's an opportunity for Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

53' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
51' Carlos Soler (West Ham) is the one who receives a yellow card.
49' Matt Doherty (Wolves) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
48' Dangerous play by Matt Doherty (Wolves). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Matt Doherty (Wolves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' The whistle blows and John Brooks starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Matt Doherty (Wolves) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Matt Doherty (Wolves). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
45' Emerson (West Ham) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
44' Aaron Wan-Bissaka swings the cross over. Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
44' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
40' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
39' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
38' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
37' Emerson (West Ham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
37' Emerson (West Ham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Good work from West Ham as they win a corner.
37' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. West Ham will take a corner kick.
35' The ball rebounds to Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
35' West Ham take a short corner kick.
34' Sam Johnstone comes off his line to intercept the corner from Emerson (West Ham). West Ham force a corner. They send men into the box.
33' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Sam Johnstone. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
33' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) sends it out of play.

33' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and West Ham manage to earn a corner.
32' A lofted pass into the box is met by Joao Gomes (Wolves), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
30' Matt Doherty (Wolves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
29' West Ham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

29' Emerson (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.

28' Carlos Soler (West Ham) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.

26' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) after he collected a pass and unleashed his low drive. The ball was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
24' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) takes the corner with a short pass.

23' This was a piece of cake for Sam Johnstone. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
21' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
21' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' The foul by Tomas Soucek (West Ham) was seen by John Brooks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' Mario Lemina (Wolves) superbly wins the ball back and has a go from distance, but sends his effort high over the bar.
16' Max Kilman (West Ham) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
16' The referee awards a corner and Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) goes over to take it.
13' A clumsy foul by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) and John Brooks blows his whistle.
11' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
10' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
8' A rebound falls for Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender.
8' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Carlos Soler (West Ham), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

7' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. West Ham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
6' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends a long ball in, but Sam Johnstone comfortably gathers the ball.
5' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
John Brooks was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
